extDescription.message: Fill and save logins from the Khazna password manager on this computer.

notInstalled.message: Khazna is not set up for this browser yet.

notInstalledHint.message: Open Khazna on this computer, go to Settings > Browser extension and turn it on. Then restart the browser.

notPaired.message: Pair this browser with Khazna. Khazna will show this code:

pairHint.message: Allow it in Khazna only if both codes match.

pairDenied.message: Not paired. Try again and allow it in Khazna.

pairBusy.message: Khazna is already asking about another browser.

locked.message: Khazna is locked. Unlock it to fill logins.

noVault.message: Create your vault in Khazna first.

insecure.message: Khazna fills logins only on secure (https) pages.

noLoginsHint.message: Sign in on this page and Khazna offers to save the login.

fillFailed.message: Could not find a login form on this page.

error.message: Something went wrong talking to Khazna.

versionMismatch.message: Khazna was updated. Reload this extension in chrome://extensions.

promptUpdate.message: Update the password of $TITLE$ in Khazna?
